lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity local maxima are arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits. The blobs form roughly vertical columns intersecting with at least three visible horizontal rows along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-to-posterior flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high pixel values on the superior edge and a shadowed trough on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, vertical linear indentation or notch is visible on the upper lateral flank, positioned slightly anterior to the first visible gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of high-luminance blobs, contrasting sharply with the darker base color of the fin.
